csv_scope_of_work: The University of California ( UC ), Merced ( University or UC Merced ) is soliciting qualifications and proposals from a developer ( Developer or Respondent ) owning or controlling a suitable site to deliver a research laboratory facility (the Research Garage ). This solicitation, a Request for Qualifications and Proposals ("RFQ/RFP"), defines the process by which UC Merced intends to select the Developer to deliver the Research Garage. The selected Developer will work in close partnership with UC Merced to identify and retain design consultants and a general contractor. If the Respondent has identified these contractors, they should be identified and included with the response and described herein
